reviews.title: Disappointed with thin knit
reviews.comment: The knitted beanie felt thinner than I expected, and the pom-pom felt loosely attached. It didn't keep my head warm on a chilly day, and the sizing was too tight around my ears. Overall, I feel it was overpriced for the quality.

reviews.title: Cozy and stylish pom-pom beanie
reviews.comment: This knitted beanie is incredibly soft and keeps my head warm even in frosty weather. The pom-pom adds a fun touch and stays securely in place. I love the stretchy fit and the color looks exactly like the photo.
